summary: ADV-1 and ADV-2 are closed. All combined tests pass, including new symlink and permission probes. The audit binds to the new test commit.
evidence: The starting HEAD was abffa890293179224b191bfb248e3b5710582864. The audited HEAD is d987d079da5470e3a3590c59530fa8d3ba03599f, which adds only adversarial tests.
The audit read the current spec, plan, strategy, routing artifacts, debt, lessons, anti-pattern registry, both passing reviews, and the exact remediation diff.
ADV-1 withdrawn: tests/sound-set.test.ts:328-347 compares raw bytes for OggS and the identification packet. The two original high-bit regressions pass.
ADV-2 withdrawn: scripts/sound-set.mjs:74-98 contains folder and target preparation errors. Directory and overlong-name tests require the exact new D5 line.
The existing directory regression preserves keep.txt. The existing folder-obstruction regression reports the first entry and starts no child.
The combined heavy-run command passed before the test commit and after it. Both runs reported 86 passed tests across two files.
The new commit adds twelve cases. All twelve ran successfully. No permission test was skipped because the process runs as uid 1001.
tests/sound-set.adversarial.test.ts:240-268 covers output symlinks to a file, a directory, and a missing path. Preparation unlinks each symlink and preserves its destination.
The no-write symlink case preserves the destination, rejects stale bytes, suppresses child output, and starts no later render.
The output-folder symlink cases cover an existing directory, a regular file, and a missing destination. Obstructions produce the exact first-entry preparation line.
An existing output-folder symlink redirects writes outside SOUNDS_ROOT through normal filesystem resolution. D5 specifies lexical paths, not a physical-root sandbox.
The valid folder-symlink case uses a destination inside the disposable fixture but outside its configured repository. It preserves unrelated destination files.
The later-entry preparation case preserves alpha's successful file and output. It reports beta's exact failure line and never starts gamma.
The unwritable stale-target case preserves the stale file, reports the exact preparation line, and starts no child.
The unwritable sounds-folder case reports the first entry's exact preparation line. No output folder or child call appears.
An empty unwritable output folder causes the child to fail its write. The wrapper emits the exact child-failure line and suppresses the child's stack trace.
The unreadable set-file case emits the existing exact JSON-read failure line and starts no child. No new permission-specific message was invented.
Each permission test first proves that the intended read or write fails under the effective user. Each test restores permissions in finally.
A4: the isolated all-[~] fixture reports total=2, complete=0, in_progress=2, incomplete=2 through the installed interphase helper.
A7: the combined suite preserves BANNED never do not in the exact child-failure line. No filter removes the probe.
A5: the cited combined suite and doctor both exit 0. Historical Red failures remain historical failures. The audit adds no test count to the plan.
The doctor exits 0 and its boundary suite passes. Generated facts remain current after the temporary task marker is restored.
build-graph updated both test files in the external cache database. It locates the actual header reader at tests/sound-set.test.ts:328-347.
The graph does not scan the production .mjs script or model dynamic reader extraction. Direct source review covers those boundaries.
A1, A2, and A9 have no changed implementation surface. Review A retains the existing A8 marker compatibility note.
The audit changes no production source, committed audio byte, or playback route. No real earshot command ran.
The test commit contains tests/sound-set.adversarial.test.ts only. The required audit JSON and log remain separate written artifacts.
The original plan is restored. Unrelated shared changes remain untouched.
The release worktree remains detached at e01ac17b. The shelf-sync worktree and branch remain at 623e7b5d. Their owning sessions retain cleanup ownership.
Facts changed: ADV-1 and ADV-2 are closed, and the adversarial gate passes. No price, public date, product name, or deployment status changed.
